details: Malicious package. A dependency-confusion style package (version 99.1.1) whose install script runs an inline `node -e` payload that collects the package name, the user name and the hostname, looks up the public IP via `api.ipify.org`, and sends it to a hardcoded Telegram bot (bot 8236864682, chat 8655055695). Observed in a sandboxed install. The same bot is used by packages already in OSV (pa-marked, pa-marked-internal, chandan-module-test). Published 2026-04-19T19:14Z and unpublished from npm about 15 minutes later.
